name: Constell Group
verdict: Production holding created in 2007 by Krasnodar businessman Sergei Galitsky, a private individual. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: 93.ru (17 Nov 2025) names Sergei Galitsky - the founder of Magnit and FC Krasnodar - as the private businessman who created Constell Group; no state stake and no human-rights finding found. Its wordmark shares the left sleeve of FC Krasnodar's 2026/27 match shirt with ABSEL (club match photo galleries; the club shop offers a Constell-logo print option).
